assets.subject: the Spice market café, a new look of the same small café
assets.details: A tall portrait picture, 2 wide by 3 high, exactly the shape of the attached picture. The attached picture is this café's everyday look. Repaint exactly the same room from exactly the same camera, keeping every object in the same place and at the same size: the bookshelf on the left wall, the large window in the back wall, the chalkboard on the right wall (simple chalk doodles, no words), the arched doorway with the round mirror and the peach apron on its hook on the far right, the hanging plants and lamps, and the empty wooden floor filling the lower half with nothing on it. Change only the finish and the mood: warm terracotta and saffron walls, strings of dried red chillies and bay leaves, brass spice tins and small burlap spice sacks on the shelves, a mortar and pestle, late-afternoon golden light. Cosy and warm. No people, no animals, no religious figures or symbols, no altars, no words, letters or numbers anywhere, no onions, garlic or spring onions.
